m920149.では、隠れ里に案内しよう。\n物質界の王子よ、付いてきてくれ！:
Then, let us guide you to the hidden village.
Prince of the Material World, please follow us!
m920149.でも……うん……。\n本気で皆を守り続けるつもりなんだって思って、\nちょっとだ:
But... yeah...
I can tell you're serious about protecting everyone, and that made you...
a little bit cool, I guess.
m920149.でも、この侵攻から先は、\n天界も物質界を真に敵と認めることになるはず……。\n:
But from this invasion onward,
Heaven will have no choice but to recognize the Material World as a true enemy…….
After all, humans who have killed gods are now turning their blades toward the sky.
m920149.でも、それも長くは保たないかもね……。\nあんなに大勢の兵士に、魔剣もどきを\n:
But that might not last long, though…….
We're dealing with people who can arm so many soldiers
with those pseudo-magic swords.
m920149.でも、少しでも情報があるのはありがたいよ。\nそれじゃあ、この何とも言えない\n:
But it's good to have even a little information.
So, do you have any idea about this...
unmistakably warm atmosphere?
m920149.なぜ泣きそうな顔をしている。\n我輩は今、こんなに晴れやかな気持ちだというのに！:
Why do you look like you're about to cry?
I'm feeling so bright and clear-headed right now!
m920149.なっ……倒したはずなのに、復活した！？\nどうなってるのこいつ！:
Wha… I thought I defeated him, but he's back up!?
What's wrong with him!
m920149.なに、ちょっとした昔話だ。\nさぁノーマ、置いていくぞ！\nここからが本番だから:
It's just a bit of old gossip.
Come on, Norma, don't lag behind!
The real action starts now!
m920149.ならば……これが勝手な頼みだとは分かっている。\nだが、どうか私の里を助けてほし:
Then… I know this is a selfish request.
But please, help my homeland…
m920149.ならば来るがいい……ッ！！\n我を信ずるちびっこ達がいる限り、\n我は輝き続けね:
Then come and take me on…!!
As long as there are little ones who believe in me,
I must keep shining…!!
m920149.なるほどな、背後には天界の連中が\nついてるってことか。\nおい、ノーマだったか:
I see. So the Celestial Realm is pulling the strings behind this.
Hey, Norma, right? Let's head to the frontier village. Now.
m920149.なるほどね……。\n知り合いに助けを求めるために、\nあんなボロボロになってまで: I see…… So she flew all the way here, battered and bruised, just to ask an acquaintance for help……
m920149.はぁ……はぁ……っ！\nし、神獣と戦って勝ったって、\n開拓村に帰ったら全力で自:
Haa... haa...!
I-I defeated a Divine Beast...
I have to brag about it with everything I've got when I get back to the Pioneer Village...
m920149.はぁ……王国軍って元は敵だった人が多すぎない！？\n王子ったら、どれだけ器が大き:
Haa…… Aren't too many of the Kingdom's army former enemies?!
How big of a heart do you have, Prince…….
m920149.ふふ、相変わらずの心酔っぷりですね。\nそれにしても、\nなぜ神聖騎士団に追われ:
Fufu, your devotion remains as unwavering as ever.
But tell me,
why were you being chased by the Holy Knights?
m920149.ふふっ、心強い。\n魔界の民と聞いていたが、\nデーモンとも仲良くやっていけそう:
Heh, that's reassuring.
I heard you were a citizen of the Demon Realm,
but it seems we'll get along fine with Demons.
m920149.ふふん、教えてくれるなんて間抜けな邪教徒ね！\nって、あ、あれ……？\nやだ、身:
Fufu, how foolish of a cultist to tell me that!
Wait, ah, what's this…?
My strength is just draining out of me…
m920149.べ、ベヒモスに、ガルダ……？\n神獣を複数相手にするなんて、そんなの――:
B-Behemoth and Gald...?
Facing multiple Divine Beasts at once... that's just—
m920149.ほう……。\n神に逆らい、されど神の手によって\nその身を神獣にされた巨人が、こ:
Hmph…
A Giant who defied the gods, yet was turned into a Divine Beast
by the gods' own hand… at a time like this?
m920149.ぽかぽか……？\nあぁ、そう言われてみれば、\n物質界ではこの力を感じなかったな:
Warm...?
Ah, now that you mention it,
I didn't feel this power in the Material World...
m920149.ま、魔王軍幹部様が……こんなに……。\n王子ぃっ！ いったいどうなってるの！？:
I mean, the Demon King's general is… right here… like this.
Prince! What on earth is going on?!
m920149.まぁでも、最初は問題なかったの。\nこれでも元魔王軍と、物質界の開拓者が\n集ま: Well, it wasn't a problem at first. This is a village full of tough guys, after all—former Demon Army soldiers and material-world settlers alike.
m920149.むぅ。それとこれとは話が別だ。\n敵は神獣、エインヘリヤルだぞ？\nだが実に――:
Hmph. That's a separate matter.
The enemy is a divine beast, Einherjar.
But honestly――
m920149.もうっ、帰ってくるのが遅いよぉ……！！: Ugh, why did you take so long to get back……!!
m920149.もっともっと強くなっちゃうのかぁ……。\nふふっ、私も訓練、手伝っちゃおうかしら:
He's going to get even, even stronger…
Heh, maybe I should help with his training too.
m920149.もっと早く気付きなさいよ！\n元同僚でしょ！？\nそれより、あなたがいるってこと:
Took you long enough to notice!
We used to work together, didn't we?
More importantly, if you're here, then this army is—
m920149.ゆえに此度は、いまの私が行使できうる権限の、\n最高位命令をもってお相手しましょ:
Therefore, I shall face you with the highest authority
currently at my disposal.
m920149.ようやく天界へ侵攻、か。: So, the invasion of the Heavens begins at last.
m920149.わ、わけが分からないわ……！！\nでも勝てる！ これ勝てるってことよね！:
I-I don't get it…!!
But we can win! This means we can win, right?!
m920149.わ、私も王国軍なら、ちょっとくらい\n手を貸してあげてもいいかなーって思うし……: I... well, if it's the Kingdom's army, I guess it wouldn't hurt to lend them a little help...
m920149.わっ、わわわ……っ！\n下がってノーマちゃん！ まずいよこれ！！\nこの風、世界:
Wha, wh-what...!
Get back, Norma! This is bad!!
This wind is the same as when we faced the World Tree! It's the wind of the Divine Beast Gald!
m920149.ん、最初は「人類のくせに」とか言ってなかったか？: Hm, didn't you start out saying things like, "How dare you, mere human"?
m920149.んん……でも鳥人の村を助けるだけなら、\nこんな大部隊じゃなくて、少人数で\nこ:
Hmm…… but if the goal is just to save the bird-people's village,
wouldn't it be better to send a small team in quietly
rather than bringing a massive force like this?
m920149.ウフフッ、あなたは素直な良い子ねぇ。\n王国に返したのは失敗だったかしら……。:
Mm-hmm, you're a very honest child.
Perhaps returning you to the Kingdom was a mistake…
m920149.ウフフッ、この子が「王子を助けて」と叫んだから、\n天界との戦いに、一緒に挑んで:
Hehe, because this child cried out, "Help the Prince!"
I decided to join you in challenging the Heavens.
m920149.ウフフッ、すべての女の子にはねぇ、\n幸せになる権利というものがあるのよ。\nリ:
Uhuhu. Every girl has the right to be happy.
And Lina's happiness lies in being with the Kingdom.
m920149.ウフフッ、気を抜いている暇はないわよ？\nここは敵地のど真ん中なんだから。:
Fufufu. We can't afford to let our guard down.
We are right in the heart of enemy territory.
m920149.オーッホッホッホ！\nさぁ王子、天界に乗り込むわよぉ！！:
Ohoho!
Now then, Prince, let us invade Heaven!!
m920149.オーッホッホホ！！\n一番槍の名誉はゴブリン族のものよ！\nさぁ王子、人とゴブリ:
Ohoho!!
The honor of the first charge belongs to the Goblin tribe!
Come on, Prince! Let me show you the power of humans and goblins!
m920149.ガオレオン様、お待たせしました……！\n時代のスターさん……王子を連れてきました:
Gaoleon-sama, I apologize for the wait…!
I've brought the Star of the Age… the Prince!
I'll take it from here!
m920149.ガオレオン様からのお手紙をこっそり置いて――って、\nきゃぁぁああっ！？ いつか:
I'll just sneakily leave Lord Gaoreon's letter here... and—
Kyaaaaah?! How long have you been there?!
m920149.ガオレオン様が、時代のスターと呼んだ王子の力！\n時代に輝く一番星たる私に見せて:
The power of the Prince whom Lord Gaoreon called the star of the age!
Show me! I'm the brightest star shining in this era!
A-against a Divine Beast, I'm more than up to the task!!
--- scene: The Looming Giant Beast and Divine Bird (battle, end) ---
m920149.ガオレオン様に信頼されていて、\nデシウス様にここまで慕われていて、\nいったい:
Trusted by Gaorion,
and looked up to so deeply by Decius…
What kind of human is this guy, exactly…?
m920149.ガオレオン様よ！ さま！ さまを付けなさい！\n物質界に取り残された元魔王軍に、:
Say "Gaoleon-sama"! With the honorific!
He is a great being who provided a place of refuge
for the former Demon Army left behind in the material world!
m920149.ガオーッ！！\nそんな事を言い始めたら、ノーマよ、\nお前も元魔王軍である以上、:
Gaooh!!
If you start saying that, Norma,
you were part of the Demon King's army, so you're a former enemy too!!
m920149.ゴブリン族と王国軍の即席混成部隊ですが、\n皆、士気はとても高いです。\n退路は:
It is an improvised mixed force of goblins and the royal army,
but everyone's morale is very high.
We will secure a solid retreat route.
m920149.ドゥマルデ審問官！\n王国軍が迫っていると情報が入っている。\n異端の断罪は手早:
Inquisitor Domalde!
We have reports that the Kingdom's army is approaching.
I suggest we conclude the condemnation of this heretic swiftly.
m920149.ノーマから話は聞いたか？\n我らに助けを求めた鷲翼の娘は、\n異端審問官なる男に:
Did Norma tell you?
The daughter of the eagle wings who sought our help
was taken away by a man called the Inquisitor.
m920149.ノーマよッ！ 時代のチャンピオンたる王子がッ！\nこっそりこそこそなどッ！\nど:
Norma! The Prince, the champion of the age!
To sneak around like that!
It's completely unbecoming――
m920149.ハハァッ！！\n王子よ、私は貴様を味方とは思っていナイ！\nダガ！ 今だけハ手を:
Hahaa!!
Prince, I do not consider you an ally!
But! I will lend you a hand for now!
m920149.フフフ……。ちびっこだった貴様が、\n随分と頼りがいのある目をするようになったな:
Mm-hmm… The little one you were has grown
quite the dependable look in your eyes…
I leave the rest to you, Prince, Norma, and the kingdom's heroes.
m920149.フム……王子が構わないと言うなら良いのだが……。\nともあれ、模擬戦というのは初:
Hmph… If the Prince is comfortable with it, then very well…
In any case, this is my first time participating in a mock battle.
I heard it is a tradition of the Kingdom, but the scale of this one is truly exciting!
m920149.世界樹の魔物化を進め、深海に尖兵を作り出し、\n物質界の民はその対処に手一杯にな:
They pushed the corruption of the World Tree, created vanguard units in the deep sea,
and the people of the Material World were kept busy dealing with that――
That must have been the scenario they had planned.
m920149.仕方ない、撤退するぞ！\nこの娘は殺すように神託を受けている、\n奪われないよう:
Fine, we're retreating!
I've received an oracle to kill this girl.
Take her with you so she doesn't get taken!
m920149.他の魔物に喰われるなんて、ゴブリンにはよくある話。\nきっとあの子もそうだったの:
Being devoured by other monsters is a common fate for goblins.
I had long since given up, believing that is what happened to her.
m920149.信仰とか知らないし！\n人間を鎧に変えちゃうとか\n絶対邪神とかそういうやつに違:
???: I don't know anything about faith!
Turning humans into armor? That's definitely some evil god's doing!
m920149.俺は手の届く限り、全てを諦めない。\n――だから、次の千年戦争を始めよう。:
I will not give up on anything within my reach.
—So, let us begin the next Millennium War.
m920149.僻地に追いやられた私たちのような、\n鳥人種族には窺いしれないことだがな。:
It's something we birdmen, who were cast out to the remote regions,
can't really fathom.
m920149.元魔王軍幹部さんたちと、\n王国軍での模擬戦ですからね……。\nちょっと前なら、:
A mock battle between the Kingdom's army
and the former Demon King's executives…
That would have been unthinkable just a little while ago.
m920149.分かってるわよ！\n人類に頭を下げるのは癪だけど……。\nお願い王子、ガオレオン:
I know!
I hate bowing to humans, but……
Please, Prince. Save Gaoreon and that girl!
m920149.嗚呼、嗚呼！\n王子よ、お前と共に戦えることが！\n我輩は、どうしようもなく嬉し:
Ah, ah!
Prince, to be able to fight alongside you!
I am beyond words with happiness!!
m920149.天使相手に、第一波を耐え抜いたということか。\n鳥人もやるじゃないか。:
So you withstood the first wave against angels, huh.
Not bad for birdmen.
m920149.天界には、争いを抑止する結界が張られているんだ。\n全ての者は癒やしの力を常に受:
The Celestial Realm is surrounded by a barrier that suppresses conflict.
Everyone constantly receives the power of healing,
and in exchange, harming others is strictly forbidden.
m920149.天界にも、物質界の人間に似た種族がいる。\n多くは亜神に仕え、奉仕することで、\:
There are races in the Celestial Realm that resemble humans from the Material World.
Many of them serve the Lesser Gods, and in return,
they live in cities under their protection.
m920149.天界に神獣、神聖騎士団か……。\nちびっこ達が諦めないと言うのなら、\n我もまた:
Divine beasts and the Holy Knights in the Celestial Realm, huh…
If these little ones refuse to give up, then I have no choice but to raise my fists to the heavens.
m920149.天界の障壁を超える術を教えたことが罪に問われ、\n隠れ里が天使の襲撃を受けている:
We are being punished for teaching how to breach the Heavens' barrier.
Our hidden village is under siege by angels…
m920149.嬉しそうにこくこくしてても分からないわ！！\nちゃんと説明しなさい！ 人類のくせ:
Nodding like that won't explain anything!!
Give us a proper report! You humans and your secrets!!
m920149.巨人族に天界侵攻を阻む理由があるということでしょうか。\nあるいは、ヘカトンケイ:
Does this mean the Giants have a reason to stop the invasion of the Heavens?
Or perhaps Hekatoncheir could not escape the constraints
placed upon him as a Divine Beast…
m920149.当然よ！ 私は時代に輝く一番星なんだから！\nさぁ王子、隠れ里の皆を助けに行くわ:
Of course! I am the brightest star of the era!
Come on, Prince, let's go help the people of the hidden village!
m920149.怪我人なのに雄叫びをあげないでください！！\n王子、私が先行するわ。\n一緒に鳥:
Please stop roaring while you're injured!!
Prince, I'll go ahead.
Let's go save that bird-person's child together!
m920149.我々があの天界の門から、\nこの地域までを制圧したという情報を\n天界の各勢力に:
We need to make it known to all factions in the Celestial Realm
that we have secured the area from the Celestial Gate
all the way to here.
m920149.我々は即席の連合軍ですからね。\n模擬戦を繰り返して、\n連携と練度を高めていか:
We are an ad-hoc coalition, after all.
We must repeat these mock battles
to improve our coordination and proficiency.
m920149.我が同胞たちを呼ぼう。\n世界を砕くべく集まった者たちを。\n此度は、天界に抗う:
I shall call my kin.
Those who gathered to shatter the world.
This time, to resist the Celestial Realm…!!
--- scene: Heretic Inquisition (battle, start) ---
m920149.抑止力ってやつね。\nこっちに手を出したら、\n物質界連合軍が相手をするぞーって:
A deterrent, huh.
"Touch us, and you'll be dealing with the Material World Coalition."
m920149.振るう度に魔力のような何かを蓄積して、\nそれが溢れると特殊な権能を発揮する仕組:
It seems they accumulate something like mana each time they're swung,
and when it overflows, they unleash a special power.
m920149.昔ね、お使いに出した娘が、\nそのまま帰ってこなかったことがあったの。:
A long time ago, I sent a daughter out on an errand,
and she never came back.
m920149.未確認ですが、神獣ヘカトンケイルが\n巨人族を率いているとのことです。:
Unconfirmed, but it appears the Divine Beast Hekatoncheir
is leading them.
m920149.此度の失敗は我らの信仰が足らなかったということか。\n――撤退だ、撤退するぞ！\:
This failure must mean our faith was lacking.
—Fall back! We're withdrawing!
Hurry and report to the Inquisitor!
m920149.決まっている。\n……巨人狩りだ。:
That is settled.
…It is a Giant hunt.
m920149.然り、確かに乾いた地の王子に、\n我が最後の神の楔を譲り渡した。:
Indeed. I have handed over my final God's Wedge
to the Prince of the Dry Lands.
m920149.物質界では見かけないあの翼……。\nもしやあれが、天界の住人なのか？:
Those wings… I've never seen them in the Material World.
Could it be that she is a resident of the Celestial Realm?
m920149.物質界の王子、ここに\nクラールフ様がいるということは、\n神の楔は無事に受け取:
Prince of the Material World, the fact that
Kralhu-sama is here means
you received the God's Wedge safely, yes?
m920149.王国軍か……。\n我らの正当なる異端者討伐を妨害するとは。:
The royal army…
To obstruct our righteous crusade against heresy.
m920149.王国軍は、魔王軍の敵だったのよね……？: The Kingdom's army was the enemy of the Demon King's army, right…?
m920149.王子、お前たちの帰るべき道は我輩たちが守る。\n天界にお前の名を刻み込んでくるの:
Prince, we will guard the road home for you.
Go and carve your name into Heaven!!
m920149.王子、このままではノーマさんが危険です。\n彼女を守りながら戦いましょう。:
Prince, this is dangerous for Norma.
We need to fight while keeping her safe.
--- scene: Heretic Inquisition (battle, end) ---
m920149.王子、サンダーバードは本来温厚な生き物だから、\nこっちから手を出さなければ敵対:
Prince, Thunderbirds are gentle creatures by nature.
As long as we don't provoke them, they shouldn't turn hostile.
Just be careful not to get caught up in their attacks.
m920149.王子、今だけハ我が知識を貸してやろウ！\nガルダの羽ばたきにヨル、異常な風速を検:
Prince, for now, I'll lend you my knowledge!
Due to Gald's flapping, I've detected abnormal wind speeds!
Aiming for ranged attacks will become significantly more difficult!
m920149.王子たちを迎えに行くぞ。\nレオナ、人選はお前に任せる。:
We will go to meet the Prince and his party.
Leona, choose the troops.
m920149.王子の強さはひとりの強さじゃなくて、\n皆が強くて、その上\n皆が王子の所に集ま:
The Prince's strength isn't just about being strong on his own.
Everyone is strong,
and because everyone has gathered to the Prince's side, we're even stronger.
m920149.王子よ、今の我輩は何者にも負ける気がしない。\n第二形態を解放するタイミングは貴:
Prince, I feel invincible right now.
I'll leave the timing for my second form to you!
m920149.王子よ、我も必ず後を追う。\n先にあの娘を助けに走るのだ……ッ！！\nガオォッ…:
Prince, I will surely follow you.
I will race ahead to save that girl…!!
GAO… GAOOOO!!
m920149.王子殿、ちょっとマズイです。\nあの騎士、信じられない耐久力と守りの硬さですよ！:
Your Highness, this is getting a bit tricky.
That knight has incredible durability and defense!
m920149.異端者にもお前のような武人がいたことは\n心に刻んでおこう。\nだが、異端は全て:
I shall commit to memory that even among the heretics,
there existed a warrior of your caliber.
But all heresy must be purged.
m920149.確かに、あちらの方角に多数の砂煙が見えます。\nあれは……た、大変です！\n角の:
Indeed. I can see a lot of dust clouds in that direction.
That's… oh no!
A girl with horns is being chased!
m920149.祈りが死を超越し、霊魂となっても戦う騎士、\nホワイトクルセイダーだ。\n信仰の:
A prayer that transcends death, turning the knight into a spirit.
This is the White Crusader.
Behold the majesty of the knight of faith!
m920149.神の楔の加護がありますから、障壁も超えられますね。\n――あれ？ でも前のときと:
With the protection of the Divine Wedge, we can pass through the barrier.
――Huh? But the scenery looks a little different
from last time...
m920149.討伐には精鋭がいればいい、侵攻もまた然り。\nけれど制圧し、そこを防衛するには軍:
For extermination, an elite force is enough. The same goes for invasion.
But to subdue and defend a territory, you need an army.
And that is precisely what our goblin clan excels at, you know?
m920149.貴様、我らが主を愚弄したな……！？\nその首、この場で叩き落としてくれる！！:
You dare mock our master……!?
I will strike that head off your shoulders right here!!
m920149.追っている側は、どうやら神聖騎士団のようですね。\n王子、見逃すわけにはいきませ:
The pursuers appear to be members of the Holy Knights.
Prince, we cannot simply stand by and watch.
Let's go save that woman!

The War God Colosseum has no use for those without a will to fight.
m920233.僭越ながらウルカノ様、マレス様はこう言いました。\nこの俺様を利用しようというそ:
With all due respect, Lord Vulcano, Lord Males said this:
He approves of the spirit behind your attempt to use him.
m920233.元々、この森の蟲使いには招待状が届いていたらしい。\nハニービーが外部の伝手を使:
Apparently, the Insect users of this forest had received invitations long ago.
Honeybee must have used outside contacts to reach out to them.
m920233.初めまして、アタシは蟲王国のハニービー。\n今回の戦神コロッセウムでみんなの案内:
Nice to meet you. I'm Honeybee from the Insect Kingdom.
I'll be your guide for this War God Colosseum.
Please feel free to call me “Sister Bee”♪
m920233.初戦の相手はこのアタシ、ハニービーが務めます。: I, Honeybee, will be your opponent in the first match.
m920233.別に私だって疑ってたわけじゃない。\nだけど、先入観は野生の勘を鈍らせる。:
It's not that I was doubting you.
But preconceptions can dull one's wild instincts.
m920233.勘違いするなよ、蟲の森の繭守よ。\n俺様はお前たちを救いに来たわけではない。:
Don't get the wrong idea, cocoon-keeper of the Insect Forest.
I didn't come here to save you.
m920233.大切な友達を盾にされたら、私たちは何もできない。: With our dear friends being used as shields, there was nothing we could do.
m920233.女王、覚悟を決めた方が良い。: Queen, it is best you make up your mind.
m920233.女王と一緒に私たちの森にやって来た人間。\n噂では、女王の義理の娘だって話もある: A human who came to our forest with the Queen. There are rumors that she is the Queen's adopted daughter.
m920233.女王の目的は王国攻略のための兵隊を集めることだった。\nでも、そんなことに協力な:
The Queen's goal was to gather troops for a conquest of the kingdom.
But there's no way we could help with something like that.
m920233.女王は森の蟲たちを操って軍備を整えている。\nそして、その標的は王国……王子ちゃ: She is manipulating the insects of the forest to build up her military forces. And her target is the Kingdom... you all, Prince.
m920233.強さとは己が肉体によってのみ証明される。\n机上でどれだけ議論を尽くそうと意味は:
Strength is proven only by one's own flesh.
No amount of armchair debate will change that.
m920233.恐れよ人類！ 弱き者たちの振るう致命の一撃！\n自らも最強に名乗りを上げんとする:
Fear us, humanity! The lethal strike of the weak!
The first sign of rebellion, as they too claim the title of strongest!
m920233.悪くない選択肢だ。前向きに検討しておこう。: That's a fair offer. I'll consider it seriously.
m920233.感謝するよ、戦神マレス。\n私は特定の神を崇めてはいないが、\n今後祈ることがあ:
I am grateful, War God Mares.
I do not worship any specific deity, but
if I ever need to pray, I shall direct my prayers to you.
m920233.我が名はヴェルミス、蟲王国が女王の忠実なる下僕。\n王国よ……女王に会いたければ:
My name is Verumis, a loyal servant of the Queen of the Insect Kingdom. Kingdom... if you wish to meet the Queen, defeat me first.
--- scene: The Queen's True Identity (battle, end) ---
m920233.我らが蟲王国のエース、ココンちゃんを。: Our ace of the Insect Kingdom, Cocon-chan.
m920233.戦神コロッセウム、バグズリベリオンの開幕だぜッ！: The War God Colosseum, Bugs Rebellion, is about to begin!
m920233.戦神コロッセウムは王国を森に呼ぶための建前。: The War God Colosseum was merely a pretext to lure the Kingdom into the forest.
m920233.戦神マレスは自ら物質界の紛争には干渉しない。\nだが、戦いを求める者がいればそこ:
The War God Mares does not interfere with conflicts in the Material World on his own accord.
But if someone seeks battle, he will appear.
m920233.攻めてくる──と言うと、少し語弊があるな。\nここで戦神コロッセウムの決勝が開か:
“Attacking” is a bit of an exaggeration.
The finals of the War God Colosseum are to be held here.
m920233.最強の生物とは何か、その問いに答えはない。: There is no answer to the question of what the strongest creature is.
m920233.最強の生物を語る際に欠かせぬ者たち。それは──: There are those who are essential to any discussion of the strongest creature. They are──
m920233.最近はめっきり姿を見せんから、\n吾輩も心配しておったのじゃぞ？:
It has been quite some time since I last saw you,
so I was beginning to worry.
m920233.気を付けて！ 女王の特濃フェロモンが──: Watch out! The Queen's extra-concentrated pheromones are—
m920233.王国へのこの恩は絶対に忘れないわ。\nもしアタシにできることがあれば何でも言って:
We will never forget this kindness to the Kingdom.
If there's anything I can do, just say the word.
I'll drop everything to help, as long as it's not the Honeybees.
m920233.王国を巻き込むことになって\n悪いとは思っているけどね……。: I do feel bad for dragging the kingdom into this, though……
m920233.王国を急襲するつもりが、結局は機先を制された。\n戦神マレスを引っ張り出されては: ??? : I intended to ambush the Kingdom, but in the end, I was outmaneuvered. Now that the War God Mares has been dragged into this, I can't back down.
m920233.王子……貴方たちに、戦ってほしい相手がいる。: Prince... there is someone who wants you to fight.
m920233.王子よ、貴殿を蟲王国に招待しよう。\nハニービー、ココン、案内をしてやれ。\nく:
Prince, I invite you to the Insect Kingdom.
Honeybee, Cocon, please show them the way.
Do be polite to our guests.
m920233.直接の面識はありませんね。\nハニービー、本名不詳の蜂使い。\n冒険者業界では相:
We haven't met in person, no.
Honeybee is a beekeeper whose real name is unknown.
She's quite the celebrity in the adventurer circuit.
m920233.私がお前たちの次の相手ということだ、王子よ。: ??? : It means I am your next opponent, Prince.
m920233.私たちはそれを早めてあげた。むしろ感謝してほしい。: We simply sped things up. If anything, you should be thanking us.
m920233.私の名前はココン、蟲の森の繭守。\n戦神コロッセウムのルールに則り、\n貴方たち:
My name is Cocon, the Cocoon Guardian of the Insect Forest.
In accordance with the rules of the War God Colosseum,
I challenge you to a duel.
m920233.私はただ、我が神の御心に従うのみです。: I am merely following the will of my god.
m920233.私は蟲王国なんて口にするのも嫌。あそこは私たちの森。: I hate even saying the words "Insect Kingdom." That place is our forest.
m920233.私も、森の環境を元に戻したらそっちに行く。: I'll come over there too, once I've restored the forest's environment.
m920233.聖人だろうが悪人だろうが知ったことか。\n俺様は戦い抜いた戦士をこそ尊重する。:
I don't care if you're a saint or a sinner.
I respect warriors who fight to the bitter end.
m920233.虚空から魔界アリを召喚した……！？: She summoned Demon Ants from the void...!?
m920233.蟲王国……いいえ、私たちの暮らしている森は、\n数か月前に現れた女王によって支配: The Insect Kingdom... no, the forest we call home has been under the control of a queen who appeared a few months ago.
m920233.蟲王国のエース、どんな方なのでしょうか。: I wonder what the ace of the Insect Kingdom is like.
m920233.蟲王国の先鋒として、蟲使いの恐ろしさを教えてあげる♪: As the vanguard of the Insect Kingdom, I'll show you how terrifying a beekeeper can be♪
m920233.行きましょう、王子。決勝の舞台、蟲王国へ。: Let's go, Prince. To the final stage: the Insect Kingdom.
m920233.表面的には女王に従いながら、反撃の隙を窺ってた。\nそんなとき、私たちの目に入っ:
On the surface, we obeyed her while looking for an opening to strike back.
And that's when this caught our eye.
m920233.計画が全て台無しだ、どう責任を取ってくれる？: ??? : You've ruined all my plans. How do you intend to take responsibility for that?
m920233.貴様がフェロモンで『強制』動員した蟲たちは、\n俺様の方で一時的に預かっておくと:
As for the insects you "forced" into service with pheromones,
I shall take temporary custody of them.
m920233.魔界アリの女王、本当にこんなとこにいやがったか……。: Demon Ant Queen, you really did show up in a place like this...
m920233.魔界アリの女王とは長い因縁もありますからね……。: We do have a long history with the Demon Ant Queen, after all……
m920233.魔界アリの女王よ、棄権するのであればそれで構わん。\n戦神コロッセウムは戦意なき:
Demon Ant Queen, if you wish to withdraw, that is your prerogative.
The War God Colosseum is no stage for those without a will to fight.
m920233.（あ、くまさんの真似をしてはちみつを食べようと、\n迂闊に蜂の巣に手を出したとき: (Ah, he's having a flashback to the trauma of carelessly reaching into a beehive to steal honey, imitating a bear.)
m920233.（いつの間にか観客まで呼んでる……！？）: (When did they even bring in an audience...!?)
m920233.（なるほど……そういうことでしたか）: (I see…… so that's how it was.)
m920233.（ハニービー、またの名をキラービー。\n殺人蜂として多くの戦場で名を馳せた冒険者:
(Honeybee, also known as Killer Bee.
An adventurer who made a name for herself on many battlefields as an assassin.
But her performance just now was a far cry from the rumors...)
m920233.（女王よ、やはり貴女は支配者の器ではない）: (Queen, you truly are not cut out to be a ruler.)
m920233.（私が期待し過ぎていたのでしょうか、それとも──）:
(Perhaps I was expecting too much, or maybe...)
--- scene: Cocoon Guardian of the Insect Forest (battle, start) ---

m940011.――それで、俺の影と、\n呪いの泥の仕組みは分かったか？: ――Now then, have you figured out how my shadow and the cursed mud work?
m940011.――たるたろすで、お前の旅路を、見届けよう。: Hyrion?: ――I will watch your journey end in Tartarus.
m940011.――どわぁぁぁぁぁ！？\nフルスー！ なんでー！？\nなんで追いかけてくるんです:
――Whaaat?!
Fuls! Why?!
Why are you chasing me?!
m940011.――はぁ。\n陛下らしくもない。\nそんな顔をしないでください。:
――Haa.
That's hardly befitting of an emperor.
Please don't look so downcast.
m940011.――ひとまず、\nこの場の巨人たちは沈黙したようです。:
――For now,
it seems the Giants in this area have been subdued.
m940011.――アンジェリーネ、\nベラドンナと共に、帝国貴族の手綱を握れ。:
――Angeline,
take control of the imperial nobles alongside Belladonna.
m940011.――タルタロスの門へ続く道: (narration): ――The road leading to the Gates of Tartarus
m940011.――ハイドースが門を開いた一瞬の隙を突き、\n呪いの主は外部への「回路」を繋ぎま:
――Exploiting the brief moment when Hyades opened the gates,
the source of the curse established a “circuit” to the outside.
m940011.――冥界の呪い、ね。: ――A curse from the Underworld, I see.
m940011.――外の世界から「回路」を断ち切る方法は、あります。: —there is a way to sever the "circuit" from the outside world.
m940011.――帝国領、巨人族の集落付近: ――Imperial Territory, near the Giant tribe's settlement
m940011.――深夜、帝都市街地: ――Late at night, Imperial Capital city center
m940011.――王子！ 次は東から敵兵が！: ――Prince! Enemy troops are coming from the east!
m940011.――行くぞ。帝国を蝕む闇を狩る旅だ。: ――Let us go. This is a hunt for the darkness that devours the empire.
m940011.――襲撃を受けた都市の被害報告は以上です。:
The buildings are in ruins,
but it is a relief that there were almost no casualties.
m940011.――身体の自由が……戻った……。\nこれ、で……終わらせよう……！:
My body... I've regained... control of it...
Now... let's end this...!
m940011.……いや、違う。これは――: ...No, that is not it. This is—
m940011.……きりがないな。\nあれから何度、呪いの泥を討伐した？:
……This is endless.
How many times have we fought the cursed mud since then?
m940011.……そんなことだろうと思いましたわ。: ……I knew that would be the case.
m940011.……ただの予感で済めばいいけど。\n神官戦士と治癒士がそろって違和感を覚えてるん:
……I hope it's just a feeling.
Both the Priestess and the Healer are sensing something off.
We need to be extra careful on tonight's patrol――
m940011.……でしたら、いくつか心当たりを記します。\nタルタロスからの転生者は、まだいま:
……In that case, I will write down a few leads.
There are still reincarnates from Tartarus among us.
m940011.……ならば、力ずくでこじ開けるまでだ。: ……Then I will force my way through.
m940011.……む？\n何だか聞き覚えのある悲鳴が聞こえたような？:
...Hm?
I feel like I heard a scream I recognize...
m940011.……やっぱり、タルタロスの\n門の方から魔力が漏れ出してる。:
……As I thought, magical energy
is leaking out from the direction of the Gates of Tartarus.
m940011.……ヒュリオン、ではないな。\nこの呪いを送り込んだ主か。:
……It is not Hyrion.
You are the master who sent this curse.
m940011.……俺の不覚だ。\nよもや、このような置き土産をされていたとはな。: ……This was my lapse in judgment. I never imagined I would be left with such a burden.
m940011.……帝都でも、夜はなんだか不気味だな。: ……Even in the Imperial Capital, the night feels eerie somehow.
m940011.……引き返しなさい。\nさもなくば、私があなた方に「死」を与えます。:
……Turn back.
Or I will grant you "death."
m940011.……悪いな、元からの性分だ。: ……I'm sorry. It's just how I am.
m940011.……殺す以外の道は？\n何でもいい、少しでも可能性があるなら、教えてくれ。:
Hyrion has barely been corrupted.
If we can sever the path of the curse now,
I believe we can save him safely.
m940011.……消えましたね。気配も、完全に。: ……It's gone. The presence is completely gone.
m940011.……理性を失っているようですね。: ...It seems they have lost their reason.
m940011.……襲撃者の中に、ひとつ目に巨躯、\n赤い角のある巨人はいましたか？:
...Among the attackers, was there a Giant
with a single eye and a large body, and red horns?
m940011.……貴様の民が目を覚ましたあと、\n伝えたいことはあるか。:
...Once your people have awakened,
is there anything you wish to convey?
m940011.……！ ルー、下がって。\n誰か、いる……この先に……。:
……! Lu, get back.
There's someone… ahead of us…
m940011.あ、はいっ！\n先行したシノビの方から、\n一致する外見の巨人がいたと報告が！:
Ah, yes!
The Shinobi who went ahead reported
that there was a Giant matching that description!
m940011.ああ、呪われているのはこの身のみ。\nタルタロスの深奥、深き虚ろより這い出た呪い:
Yes, only this body is cursed.
The curse that crawled out of the deep void of Tartarus
is devouring my soul.
m940011.ああ。俺の命ひとつで済むのなら構わないが、\nこのままでは帝国が滅びる。:
Aye. If it can be settled with just my life, I have no objection,
but as things stand, the Empire will be destroyed.
m940011.ああ。呪いの元凶は、タルタロスの奥にある。: Yes. The root of the curse lies deep within Tartarus.
m940011.ああ。気配がしないのではない。\nこれは、待ち伏せだ。:
Ah. It is not that there is no presence.
This is an ambush.
m940011.あいにくと、俺を孤独にさせたがらない友がいてな。\nいずれ、貴様の喉元に、我が剣:
Unfortunately, I have friends who refuse to let me be alone.
Someday, I will press my blade to your throat.
I look forward to that day with great anticipation.
m940011.あなたの覚悟は、よく分かりました。\nしかし門を越えたところで、問題は解決しませ:
I understand your resolve well enough.
But crossing the gate will not solve the problem.
m940011.あの……えっと……。: You don't have to hide back there... (pulling)
m940011.あのような個体が現れたことが、\n呪いがより強くなっている証左かと。: The fact that such an entity appeared is proof that the curse is intensifying.
m940011.あれはいわば、皇帝という鋳型を通して、\nタルタロスの魔力が形を得たものです。: That was merely Tartarus's magic taking shape through the mold of the Emperor.
m940011.いいえ、関連していると見て間違いないでしょう。: No, it is safe to assume they are related.
m940011.いいえ。門の前でお話ししたとおり、\n内部に踏み入ったなら、その瞬間に\n永遠の:
No. As I told you before the gate,
if you step inside, you will be swallowed
by the eternal cycle of time in that very instant. However—
m940011.いえ、起きたのは王国ではなく……。\n――緊急の伝令です！\n現在、白の帝国の都:
No, it is not the Kingdom that is in trouble...
――This is an urgent dispatch!
The cities of the White Empire are currently under attack by Giants!
m940011.いえ。礼なら、呼び声に応えたヒュリオンと、\nその身を捧げたキュクロプスの王へ。: You're welcome. If anyone deserves thanks, it's Hyrion for answering the call, and the King of the Cyclopes for giving his life.
m940011.いえいえ。\nそれはともかく、今夜は何か起こる気配がします。\nおふたりも十分に:
Please, don't worry about it.
That aside, I sense something is about to happen tonight.
Please stay on guard, both of you―
m940011.いったい何だったんだ、あれは。\n魔物にしては、何というのか、異質な感じだった。:
What on earth was that?
Even for a monster, it felt… alien.
m940011.いつまで、そのつよがりが保つものか――: Hyrion?: How long will that bravado last――
m940011.いや、なんでもない。\n助けてやらないと、と思っただけだ。:
No, nothing.
I just thought I should help him.
m940011.いや、もうさほど保たぬだろう。: No, I fear not much is left.
m940011.いや、皆、分かってくれるだろう。:
No. They will understand.
I failed to keep the oath of non-aggression... I am sorry... White Emperor...
m940011.うぅん、あの時よりも、魔力が濃くなってる。\n何かが明確に、冥界――そして物質界:
Hmm, the magical energy is even denser than it was back then.
I think something is clearly reaching out to the Underworld―
and to the material world.
m940011.うわぁ、目がどんよりギラついてますよ。: Wow, her eyes are all hazy and glowing.
m940011.えっ、門番ってことです？\nそれってカルペムと同じ役目じゃ……。:
Ehh, so you're a gatekeeper?
That's the same role as Carpem's, isn't it…
m940011.おお、おお、裁定者殿か。\n白の皇帝、裁定者殿、そして英雄と名高き王子。\nこれ:
Oh, oh, the Arbiter.
White Emperor, Arbiter, and the Prince famed as a hero.
If this is my end, I could not ask for a better one.
m940011.お姉ちゃん、巨人さんたちに\n滅茶苦茶失礼なこと言ってる自覚あります？:
Sis, do you have any idea how incredibly rude
that is to the Giants?
m940011.お姉ちゃんが警邏中にサボって寝てたからです！\nこの一族の恥！ 駄目姉！ 愚姉ー:
Because you were sleeping on the job during patrol!
You're a disgrace to our family! Useless big sister! Idiot sister!!
m940011.お姉ちゃんと逆方向に話通じないやつですね。: She's the exact opposite of your sister when it comes to talking sense into people.
m940011.お姉ちゃんのことですよ！\n――って、あっ、すみません、\nうちの愚姉がまたご迷:
You, big sister!
―Oh, I'm sorry,
our idiot sister is causing trouble again.
m940011.ここはタルタロス。\n如何なる理由があろうと、出入りは禁じられています。:
This is Tartarus.
Entry and exit are forbidden, no matter the reason.
m940011.このあたりに出現した魔物は、\nすべて倒せたようですね。:
It seems we've defeated all the monsters
that appeared in this area.
m940011.このままでは、ヒュリオンも\nキュクロプスの王と同じく……。:
...Is there any way to save him besides killing him?
Tell me. Anything, if there is even a slight chance.
m940011.この地の者たちは、好戦的な部族とは異なる。\n温厚で、戦いを好まない者たちだ。:
The people here are different from the warlike tribes.
They are gentle souls who have no love for battle.
m940011.これだけ濃い魔力を振りまいていれば、\n嫌でも正体がわかるというものよ。: With that much raw magical power radiating, it's impossible not to know what's behind it.
m940011.これほどの武技。\nここまでに、いったいどれだけの戦いを。:
Martial skill of this caliber.
How many battles have you fought to reach this point?
m940011.これを放置すれば、呪いはさらに拡大し、\nいずれ世界そのものを呑み込むでしょう。:
If this is left unchecked, the curse will continue to spread,
until it swallows the world itself.
m940011.これ以上……タルタロスの誇りを、\n穢させて、たまるものか……。:
I cannot allow the pride of Tartarus
to be defiled any further...
m940011.こんな市街地に魔物とは……。\n付近の詰め所に連絡を！\n市民に被害が出る前に討:
A monster in the city center…
Contact the nearby garrison!
We'll exterminate it before it harms the citizens!
m940011.こんな洞窟の奥に、巨人族の集落が……？: A Giant settlement deep inside a cave like this……?
m940011.さきほど、皇帝の姿を取った呪いを斬り捨てたのに……。: But we just cut down the curse that was wearing the Emperor's form…
m940011.さすがに、あれはただの姉妹喧嘩かと。\n昇進したというのに、彼女はいつもどおりで:
I suppose that was just a sibling quarrel, after all.
Despite her promotion, she's still the same as ever…
m940011.さて、今度は、俺が追う番だ。\nタルタロスより伸びたこの影、根こそぎ断ち斬る。:
Now, it is my turn to pursue.
I will cut down the shadow that stretches from Tartarus,
root and branch.
m940011.さらに、これはあくまで可能性の話ですが……。: Furthermore, this is purely a possibility, but…
m940011.されど、心残りは我が臣下たちよ。\nタルタロスには何の縁もない巨人たちまで、\n:
But I have one regret: my subjects.
Even the giants who had no connection to Tartarus
are being corroded by the curse that invades me.
m940011.しかし、この呪いを解くためには、\nやはりタルタロスの奥へ行くしかないのではない:
But to break this curse,
don't we have no choice but to venture deep into Tartarus?
m940011.しかし、だからといって\nあなた方を中へ入れる理由にはなりません。:
However, that does not give you
a reason to be let inside.
m940011.しかし創造神は、タルタロスに幽閉されし者たちに、\nひとつの救済を用意していまし:
However, the Creator prepared
one form of salvation for those imprisoned in Tartarus.
m940011.ぜぇ、はぁ……。\n無事任務完遂しましたよ！:
Phew... haah...
Mission accomplished, as promised!
m940011.そして我が同胞、永遠の牢獄から解き放たれ、\n新たな生を歩むことを許されたこの娘:
And my kin, this girl who was released from eternal imprisonment
and permitted to walk a new path in life,
will surely be swallowed by Tartarus again if things continue like this.
m940011.その原因を絶つことなく、\n踵を返すことはできません。:
We cannot turn back
without cutting off its source.
m940011.その呪いは例の泥を生み出し、\nそれらが周辺の魔力を歪めきったところで、\nより:
That curse generates the mud we saw,
and once it has thoroughly distorted the surrounding magical energy,
it takes the form of a shadow, manifesting as something far more powerful.
m940011.それが、あなたに刻まれた呪いであり、\n外部に干渉するための術式です。:
That is the curse engraved upon you,
a ritual formula for interfering with the outside world.
m940011.それで、あなたはどうするつもりで？: And what are you planning to do?
m940011.それでも、行くと言うのですか？: And yet, do you still intend to go?
m940011.それで十分だろう？: That concludes the damage report for the city under attack.
m940011.それにしても、よくできた妹がいると、\n姉はダメになるものなのでしょうか……。:
Still, does having a competent little sister
always make the older one slack off?
m940011.それらすべてが、先ほどご報告した\n「皇帝陛下の影」と関連しているかは、\nまだ: It is not yet clear whether all of these incidents are connected to the "Shadow of the Emperor" I mentioned earlier, but……
m940011.たたかいつづけよ。\n呪いを振りまき、孤独に、戦い続けよ。:
Hyrion?: Keep fighting.
Spread the curse, and fight on in solitude.
m940011.だからあれですよ。\nよく王国との合同演習で聞こえてくる――:
Well, you know.
The kind we often hear during the joint exercises with the Kingdom—
m940011.だからこそ、帝国は庇護下におきつつ、\nできるだけ干渉を避けていたのよね。:
That is precisely why the Empire placed them under its protection,
while doing its best to avoid interfering in their affairs.
m940011.だが、ティシファ、\n貴様も誰かを頼ることを覚えた方がいい。:
But, Tisipha,
you would do well to learn to rely on others, too.
m940011.だが、原因が分かっているのなら話は早い。: However, now that we know the cause, we can act swiftly.
m940011.だが、肝心の王の姿がどこにもないな……。: But the King himself is nowhere to be found...
m940011.っ、これは……！？: I see. Hyrion is also a reincarnate...
m940011.で、あれば、話は早い。\n我が使命はタルタロスの門を\n越えんとする者すべての断:
Then this will be quick.
My duty is to condemn all who attempt
to cross the gate of Tartarus.
m940011.では、ますますここを通すわけにはいきません。: Then I certainly cannot let you pass.
m940011.でも、どうして、\n無関係なあなたがそこまで――:
I've had enough of being left behind.
And of leaving others behind.
m940011.でも、様子が変です！\nなんだか目が虚ろで……。:
But something is wrong with them!
Their eyes look vacant...
m940011.どういうことだ。:
Even after reincarnating into the material world, the core of the soul
remains tethered to the prison of Tartarus.
m940011.なぜ、私の名を。: Why do you know my name?
m940011.なっ……！？\nキュクロプスの王が、自ら胸に刃を……。:
Wha...!?
The King of the Cyclopes is driving a blade into his own chest...
m940011.ならば、こちらから乗り込んで、\nその元凶を叩き斬るまでだ。: Then we shall march in ourselves and destroy it.
m940011.ならば、止めるしかあるまい。: Then we have no choice but to stop them.
m940011.なるほど、あなたが外の世界の門番でしたか。: I see. So you are the guardian of the gate to the outside world.
m940011.なるほど、常にタルタロスの魔力を注がれていると。\nどんな魔法でも\nこの呪いを:
I see. It is constantly being fed by the magic of Tartarus.
Now I understand why
no spell can break this curse…
m940011.なるほど。あなたのその影、そしてまとわりつく淀んだ気配。: I see. That shadow of yours, and the stagnant aura clinging to you.
m940011.なん、だ……？\n身体が、熱く……。:
What, is this……?
My body is burning……
m940011.はぁ……。切っても切ってもドロドロで、\nすごく気味が悪かったです……。:
Phew… No matter how much we cut it, it just oozed and oozed.
It was really creepy…
m940011.はぁ……断る余地はなさそうですね。: Haa… I suppose I have no room to refuse.
m940011.はっ。現在、帝都の各所で\n同様の「黒い泥」の目撃情報が相次いでいます。: Yes, sir. We are currently receiving reports of the same "black mud" appearing in various parts of the Imperial Capital.
m940011.はっ！ そんなことより大変なんですよ！\n皇帝陛下はこちらにいますか！？:
Hah! But that is not the important part!
Is His Imperial Majesty here!?
m940011.ば、馬鹿な……陛下！？\nいや、黒い泥が陛下の形を模しているというのか！？:
N-No way… Your Majesty?!
No, is the black sludge mimicking Your Majesty's form?!
m940011.ひっ……！？ へ、陛下の影から、\nあの黒い泥が……湧き出してる……！？: H-Huh……!? T-The black mud is……welling up from Your Majesty's shadow……!?
m940011.ひとまず帝都へ戻る。\n情報を整理し、打てる手を洗い出す。: For now, we return to the imperial capital. We need to organize the information and figure out what we can do.
m940011.ふたりとも、気を抜かないように。\nここから先は、何が起こるかわかりません。:
Both of you, don't let your guard down.
We have no idea what's waiting for us beyond this point.
m940011.ふふっ、別にからかったわけではないですよ。\nそれに私も、ずっと何か、嫌な予感が:
Heh, I wasn't trying to tease you.
Besides, I've had a bad feeling about something for a while now.
m940011.ほぇー。巨人族って、もっとこう、\nうおー！ どかーん！ って\n暴れてるイメー:
Oh, wow. I always imagined Giants were more like,
"Roar!" and "Boom!"
You know, just tearing everything up.
m940011.まぁまぁ、門なんてドカンと叩き壊せば、\n黒幕のところまで一直線に――:
Easy, easy. If we just smash the gates to pieces,
we can go straight to whoever's pulling the strings―
m940011.まだ仮説でしかありませんが――: It is still only a hypothesis, but――
m940011.まったく、きりがないな。\n無事にキャリーが援軍を連れてきてくれればいいが――:
Honestly, this is never-ending.
I just hope Carrie arrives safely with reinforcements――
m940011.まるで、立ち去った後のような……？: It is as if they have already left...?
m940011.まるで、陛下をタルタロスへ近づけまいと、\n足止めをしているかのようですね……。:
It's as if they're holding your feet back, Your Majesty…
Trying to keep you from getting any closer to Tartarus.
m940011.もし、その無限の苦しみの中で\n「死」を迎えることができた者がいたなら、\nその:
If one could meet "death"
amidst that infinite suffering,
their soul would be granted a new life in the material world.
m940011.もしかして、あなたは……ティシファ……？: Could it be that you are… Tisipha…?
m940011.ゆえに、あなた方を通すのではなく、\n私が、呪いの解決に助力します。:
Therefore, rather than letting you through,
I will be the one to assist in resolving the curse.
m940011.わっ、わっ……えっと、助けてくれて、ありがとう……？: W-wait… um, thank you for saving me…?
m940011.わわっと！？\nアネットじゃないですか。\nそんなに急いで、何かあったんですか？:
W-Whoa?!
Anette, is that you?
You look like you're in a hurry. Did something happen?
m940011.アネットのフェンリルが、\nまだ警戒態勢を解いていない……。:
Anette's Fenrir
still hasn't dropped its guard…
m940011.キュクロプスの王……。\n巨人の集落が、帝国領内の西の方にあったかも。:
The King of the Cyclopes…
I think there was a giant settlement in the western part of the Empire's territory.
m940011.キュクロプスの王、か。: So, the King of the Cyclopes...
m940011.キュクロプスの王、か。\nまだ理性は残っているのか？:
The King of the Cyclopes...
Do you still have any reason left?
m940011.キュクロプスの王が\n常にタルタロスの呪いを受けていたように、\n陛下にも、呪い:
Just as the King of the Cyclopes was constantly subjected to the curse of Tartarus,
the power of a curse continues to flow into Your Highness as well.
m940011.キュクロプスの王が、最後の理性で\n被害を抑えていたのだろう。:
Hyrion has also regained consciousness.
It seems we can consider this matter resolved.
m940011.キュクロプスの王の願いは、\n穏やかに、静かに、仲間と共に暮らすことだったそうだ:
The Cyclops King's wish was simply to live
peacefully, quietly, and alongside his kin.
……That is what the previous king told me.
m940011.キュクロプスの王よ、貴様の民に伝播している呪いは、\n貴様を止めれば消えるのか？:
King of the Cyclopes, will the curse spreading among your people
be lifted if I stop you?
m940011.タルタロスから物質界へ転生した、古い友です。\nきっと、私のことはもう、覚えてい:
He is an old friend who was reincarnated
from Tartarus into the material world.
He surely doesn't remember me anymore.
m940011.タルタロスという贖罪の牢獄から、\n外の世界へ腕を伸ばす者がいるのなら、\nそれ:
If there is someone reaching out from the prison of atonement known as Tartarus
toward the outside world,
it is my duty to condemn them.
m940011.タルタロスに由来する魔力は、\n呪いによって指向性をもたせられていますが、\n本:
The magical energy originating from Tartarus is given direction by the curse,
but in its original state, it is a purer force, closer to a primal power――
m940011.タルタロスの門の向こう、\n無数の封じられし者たちが溢れ出さぬよう、\n咎人を処:
I have heard that beyond the gate of Tartarus,
there is an arbiter who judges the guilty,
preventing the countless sealed ones from spilling out.
m940011.タルタロスは、死が訪れず、\n無限の生をループする牢獄です。:
Tartarus is a prison where death never comes,
and infinite life loops endlessly.
m940011.タルタロス内部は、物質界の生命が\n踏み入って無事で済むような環境ではありません:
The interior of Tartarus is not an environment
where life from the material world can enter and remain unharmed.
m940011.ディアナ、武力は貴様に任せる。\n場合によっては、そのまま皇帝の座を引き継げ。:
Diana, I leave the use of force to you.
If necessary, take the throne yourself.
m940011.ヒュリオンから、タルタロスの気配が消えていく……。: The presence of Tartarus is fading from Hyrion……
m940011.ヒュリオンの魔力反応も落ち着いています。\n呪いは無事に解けたみたいですね。:
Hyrion's magical reaction is stabilizing.
It seems the curse has been lifted.
m940011.ヒュリオンは、まだほとんど侵食されていません。\n今ならまだ、呪いの経路さえ断ち:
But why are you, a stranger,
going to such lengths...?
m940011.フッ……こんな状況の玉座でよければくれてやるが。: Fff… If you're willing to sit on a throne in this kind of mess, I'll hand it over.
m940011.ルー、お疲れ様。\n泥だらけになっちゃったね。\nあとで綺麗にしてあげるから。:
Lu, good job.
You're covered in mud.
I'll clean you up later.
m940011.一歩踏み入った瞬間から、\nあなたの時間が永遠に引き伸ばされ、\nそれ以上進むこ:
The moment you take that first step,
your time will be stretched out forever,
and you will be unable to advance any further.
m940011.不可侵とはすなわち、\n民にもその存在を伏せている、ということだからな。:
A pact of non-aggression means, in other words,
that their very existence is kept hidden from the people.
m940011.不可侵の誓い……守れず、すまぬ……白の皇帝よ……。:
No apology is needed.
You resisted to the very end. That is enough.
m940011.事情は理解しました。\n咎人でありながら物質界に手を伸ばす所業、\n私も決して許:
I understand your situation.
I, too, will never forgive a sinner for reaching into the material world.
m940011.以前、ハイドースが門を一瞬だけ開いた影響が\nまだ残っているのかしら。: Is it a lingering effect from when Hyades opened the gates for just a moment?
m940011.何だ、その聞き覚えのある悲鳴というのは。: What do you mean by a scream you recognize?
m940011.俺がここにいれば、帝都に\nタルタロス由来の怪物が溢れかえるかもしれないのだろう:
If I stay here, monsters born from Tartarus
might flood the capital, wouldn't they?
m940011.俺がどこかにとどまると、\nそこに俺の影が現れるということか。: So, wherever I stay, my shadow will appear there.
m940011.俺は止まるわけにはいかない。\n退かぬというなら、貴様ごと斬り伏せる！:
I cannot stop here.
If you refuse to move, I will cut you down!
m940011.元から、そんなに強がりなわけでもない。\nこんな夜には、人並みに警戒だってする。:
I wasn't always pretending to be tough.
On nights like this, I'm just as vigilant as anyone else.
m940011.光も温もりも届かない、\n時を永遠に繰り返し続ける牢獄。\n罪人はその檻の中、永:
A prison where neither light nor warmth can reach,
where time repeats itself in an endless loop.
The sinners are confined within those bars,
to be imprisoned forever.
m940011.全軍、俺に続け。\nこのまま一気に突破する。:
All units, follow me.
We're breaking through in one go.
m940011.冗談が言えるならまだ大丈夫そうですね。\n――アネット、この先の状況は？:
If you can still joke around, then you're doing fine.
―Anette, what's the situation ahead?
m940011.分かった。\nティシファと言ったか？:
Understood.
Was it Tisipha you said your name was?
m940011.初代のふたりにも、連絡を密に取るようにしろ。\nいざとなれば、必ず力になってくれ:
Keep in close contact with the two from the first generation as well.
If things get desperate, they will surely lend us their strength.
m940011.到着した時点で街壁が破壊されていたのが痛いな……。\n王子、東門はこちらで引き受:
It's a shame the city walls were already breached by the time we arrived...
Prince, we'll handle the East Gate.
Leave the defense of the plaza to us!
m940011.前に見た、皇帝陛下そっくりな影！！: A shadow that looks exactly like His Majesty the Emperor!
m940011.向こうから姿を見せてくれれば話は簡単だが……。: If they'd just show themselves, this would be easy…
m940011.向こうの区画で、黒いどろどろした魔物が出たの。\nあちこちに出現してるから、ここ:
A black, sludge-like monster appeared in the district over there.
It's popping up in multiple places, so it might show up here too.
m940011.呪いの泥って、無限に湧くのかしらねぇ？: Does the cursed mud just keep spawning endlessly?
m940011.命までは奪わん。そこをどけ。: I will not take your life. Move aside.
m940011.外の世界から……？ どういうことだ？: From the outside world…? What do you mean?
m940011.少なくとも、タルタロスの内部で\n何が起きているのか、\n多少なりとも知ることが:
At the very least, we should be able to learn
something about what is happening
inside Tartarus.
m940011.帝国軍！ 良かった、\n伝令は無事に届いたようだな。:
The Imperial Army! Good,
the messenger must have delivered the message safely.
m940011.幸い、王国軍が陣を張っていた場所が近かったため、\n現在王子が精鋭を率いて防衛に:
Fortunately, the Kingdom's army was stationed nearby,
so the Prince is leading an elite force to defend them!
m940011.建物はめちゃくちゃですが、\n人的被害がほとんどなかったのが幸いですね。:
The King of the Cyclopes likely used his last shred of reason
to minimize the damage.
m940011.心当たりがあるようだな。\nならば、そこを退け。:
You seem to know exactly what you are dealing with.
Then, move aside.
m940011.必ず、すべてを解決する。\n貴様の力を、貸してくれ。:
You must resolve this, no matter what.
Lend me your strength.
m940011.恩に着る。\n貴様の断罪、俺たちも手を貸すと誓おう。:
I accept your kindness.
I swear that we, too, will lend a hand in your condemnation.
m940011.我らは破壊神の被造物……。\n誇りをもって、世界の行く末を戦った、者……。:
We are the creations of the God of Destruction...
Those who fought for the fate of the world... with pride...
m940011.敵が俺の姿を取ろうと、関係ない。\nヒュリオンを呪いから解き放ち、\n俺の似姿を:
It does not matter if the enemy wears my face.
I will free Hyrion from the curse,
and strike down this imitation. ――Let us go.
m940011.敵の勢いが収まったな。\n今のうちに、タルタロスの門まで一気に抜けるぞ。:
The enemy's momentum is fading.
Let's push through to the Gates of Tartarus while we can.
m940011.止めても、聞いてくれそうにありませんね。: It seems you won't listen, even if I try to stop you.
m940011.死期が近い者同士、分かることもあるということだ。: Those whose end is near often understand each other.
m940011.民を守るためならば、\nどんな地獄であろうと踏み入る覚悟はできている。:
If it means protecting my people,
I am prepared to step into whatever hell awaits.
m940011.気の長い話だな……。: That sounds like it will take a long time…
m940011.決まりだ。\n――これよりキュクロプスの王の領地へ向かう。:
Then it's settled.
――We will head to the King of the Cyclopes' territory.
--- scene: The One Who Judges the Guilty (battle, start) ---
m940011.油断していると皇帝の座、簒奪しますよ。: If you let your guard down, I'll seize the throne.
m940011.準備を急げ。これより、\n冥界の深淵……タルタロスの門を目指す。: Prepare at once. We are heading for the gate to the abyss of the Underworld……Tartarus.
m940011.物質界に転生しても、その魂の根幹は、\n牢獄たるタルタロスに結びついています。:
If we do nothing, Hyrion will suffer the same fate
as the King of the Cyclopes...
m940011.王国のワルキューレだったな。\nどうした、王国になにか起きたのか？:
So you are the Valkyrie from the Kingdom.
What is it? Has something happened in the Kingdom?
m940011.現在、タルタロスに由来する呪いが\n物質界に影響を及ぼしています。:
Currently, a curse originating from Tartarus
is affecting the material world.
m940011.生きたまま足を踏み入れれば、\nその魂はたちまち摩耗し、\n永遠の苦しみを味わう:
If you step inside while still alive,
your soul will wear away in an instant,
and you will be forced to taste eternal suffering.
m940011.白の皇帝よ、どうか、我が民を――: White Emperor, please... save my people――
m940011.皆さん、警戒を。\n何かが潜んでいるのかもしれません！:
Everyone, stay alert.
Something might be lurking nearby!
m940011.皇帝。あなたの身にかかった呪いが、\nよりその深さを増しています。: Emperor. The curse on you is growing even deeper.
m940011.皇帝がこのまま帝都にとどまれば、\n呪いの泥が際限なく蔓延し、国を蝕むことになる: If the Emperor remains in the Imperial Capital, the cursed mud will spread without limit and devour the nation.
m940011.知らなくとも無理はない。\nこの地の巨人族と白の帝国は、\n互いに不可侵の誓いを:
It's no wonder you didn't know.
The Giants of this land and the White Empire
have exchanged a pact of non-aggression.
m940011.破壊神の誇りと、創造神の慈愛によって\n再び得たこの生を、臣下たちの未来の、礎に:
This life, regained through the pride of the God of Destruction
and the compassion of the God of Creation... shall be the foundation for my subjects' future...
m940011.確かに、それはタルタロスに封じられし、\n私たちに連なる魔力に違いありません。:
Indeed, that must be the power sealed within Tartarus,
the same power that binds us.
m940011.確かに、妙ですね。\nタルタロスの残り香、\n王の魂の気配は確かにあります。です:
Indeed, it is strange.
The lingering scent of Tartaros,
and the aura of the King's soul are definitely there. But...
m940011.私はタルタロスの門の、\n向こう側を求める者を阻む門番よ。\nでも、あの子は――:
I am the gatekeeper of Tartarus.
I bar the way to those who seek to pass beyond the gate.
But that one is――
m940011.私も服が泥だらけです……。\n帰ったら絶対にお風呂に長時間浸かりますからね……。:
My clothes are covered in mud, too….
I'm definitely going to soak in the bath for a long time when we get home…
m940011.端的に言えば、陛下はいま、\nタルタロスに閉じ込められた強大な魔力の、\nいわば:
To put it bluntly, Your Highness has become
something like a gate to the material world
for the immense magical energy sealed within Tartarus.
m940011.素直に立ち去るのであれば、危害は加えません。\nどうか、二度とここへは近づかぬよ:
If you will leave peacefully, I will do you no harm.
Please, do not come near here again.
m940011.総員、剣を取れ。奴らを制圧する。: All hands, draw your swords. Subdue them.
